gizmo.title: Malo oponyera pa chithunzi
gizmo.description: Ophunzira amayika zilembo pa malo oyikidwa pamwamba pa chithunzi, kenako amayang'ana yankho lawo.

configure.title: Zolemba zina
configure.description: Chimafotokoza chithunzi kwa anthu omwe sangathe kuchiwona. Musaulule komwe zilembo zikupita.

configure.title: Mutu wa chithunzi
configure.description: Mutu wachidule wowoneka wa chithunzi, wowonetsedwa pamwamba pake.

configure.title: Funso
configure.description: Zomwe ophunzira afunsidwa kuchita ndi zilembo.

configure.title: Zilembo ndi malo
configure.description: Chinthu chilichonse ndi chilembo chomwe ophunzira angayike. Patsani chilembo dzina la malo kuti muyike malo ake pa chithunzi; chilembo chopanda dzina la malo ndi chowonjezera chomwe sichili kwina kulikonse. Manambala a malo ndi maperesenti a chithunzi.

configure.title: Mawu ofotokozera
configure.description: Mawu ofotokozera osankha owonetsedwa pansi pa chithunzi.

advanced.title: Kuyesa
advanced.description: Kangati wophunzira angayang'ane. 0 imatanthauza mopanda malire.

advanced.title: Sakanizani zilembo
advanced.description: Onetsani zilembo motsatira kosiyana nthawi iliyonse mukabwera.

advanced.title: Yopindika
advanced.description: Onetsani funsoli ngati mzere womwe umatseguka ndi kutseka. Kutsegula limodzi kumatseka mafunso ena opindika omwe ali pafupi nalo.

advanced.title: Yambani mopindidwa
advanced.description: Ikakhala yopindika, yambani ngati mzere wotsekedwa womwe umawonetsa funso ndi momwe lilili kokha.

advanced.title: Mtundu wa kupereka magiredi
advanced.description: OER Schema: mtundu wa kupereka magiredi pa kuyesa uku (mwachitsanzo mapointi, chilembo, peresenti, kumaliza).

advanced.title: Cholinga cha maphunziro
advanced.description: OER Schema: cholinga cha maphunziro chogwirizana ndi kuyesa uku.

developer.title: Dzina la mayeso
developer.description: Dzina la mayeso logwiritsidwa ntchito pozindikiritsa xAPI m'machitidwe owunika.

developer.title: Maphunziro
developer.description: OER Schema: maphunziro omwe kuyesa uku kwapangidwira.
